sloka: अथ आरुरोह तेजस्वी स्वयम् लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः ।ततः निषाद अधिपतिर् गुहो ज्ञातीन् अचोदयत् ॥२-५२-७७॥
transliteration: atha āruroha tejasvī svayam lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ ।tataḥ niṣāda adhipatir guho jñātīn acodayat ॥2-52-77॥

translations.english: With the boat boarded by the glorious Rama, Lakshmana's elder brother, Guha, king of the nishadas urged his kinsmen (to row the boat).
